name: Sydney Watkins
original_name: シドニー・ワトキンス
source:
"It was rude of me to suddenly hug a young lady who I don't know. Can you please forgive me?"

He is a British journalist for the newspaper "London Echo."  He is investigating a series of bizarre murders in Yokohama.

He is cheerful, sociable, and a feminist.

[Translated from [url=https://www.otomate.jp/chouchoujiken/chara/index3.php]official website[/url]]
